scope: Isolated representative proposal. Not SEC-05 cutover acceptance.
engine: PostgreSQL 18.3 (PGlite 0.5.8) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit

replay.limitation: Synthetic rows; captured public schema/policies/unique indexes/constraints/all 3 triggers. Auth users/sessions are minimal column fixtures, not real Auth. No production, PostgREST, Edge deployment, Realtime or browser scoring invocation.

results.name: All 18 tables deny direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE to anon and authenticated
Both log_player_go overloads deny anon and authenticated EXECUTE individually
Writable owner view blocks every write and preserves existing SELECT
Direct service RPC denies public role despite guessed request and registry hashes
Private registry and Auth session tables inaccessible to public roles
Protected mutation without controller is denied before SQL
Guessed well-formed capability cannot claim historical match
Current client -> handler -> actual SQL creates new match and stores only capability hash server-side
Match A controller cannot alter Match B even with known IDs
Low-friction registration creates a new stable player without modifying same-name profile
Roster join, reorder, removal and scoped display edit preserve persistent profiles
Resume/reconnect uses credential cache as proof only when live registry accepts it
Game reservation is server-assigned, sequential and retry-idempotent
Malformed boards, forged stats and nested foreign-match IDs are denied without commit
Lost completion response resumes exact payload and produces one game and one score per player
Conflicting completion cannot overwrite accepted throws or scores
Approved six-argument go wrapper records frozen-roster event and accepts exact retry only
Own failed-save cleanup changes pending slot only; completed and foreign games protected
Accepted participant replacement and late joins after Game2 reservation are denied
Practice, Turbo and Vs Shadow persist correct isolated scores and real players
Saved-player positive-score eligibility excludes guest and zero high-score rows
Turbo permits guests while Vs Shadow permits exactly one real player
Expired and revoked controllers fail live registry recheck; cache cannot revive them
Empty controller-created match cleanup removes private pending scope and never accepted history
Recovery cache enqueue failure prevents submission; acknowledgement failure retains exact retry
Admin and commentary cannot be authorized by controller, UI flags or arbitrary JSON authority
Admin requires permanent confirmed user, allowlist and live matching session every request
Safe hold rejects writes, preserves reads/resume/pending payload; trusted resumption retains closure

limitations: No deployed Edge/PostgREST/Auth/Realtime or current frontend activation.
Synthetic Auth verifier seam tests request/SQL checks, not real token validation or enrolled production admin.
Training/telemetry, full 21 admin replacement routes, full tournament/provenance parity and production safe rollback are not complete.
Controller possession authorizes score submission; fixture checks aggregate consistency, not physical dart truth or a replacement scoring engine.
Lost initial capability response cannot be recovered from public IDs; proposed trusted expired-empty pruning is tested, with no scheduled production job.
First-game late-join timing before17s requires current frontend rule verification; no client phase input is treated as server proof.
Storage recovery tests cover a single writer and a reload; concurrent tabs/instances can reintroduce stale queues and need a coordinated cache contract.
